faqs.q: Where and how are the AME International hydraulic cylinders used?
faqs.a: AME International hydraulic cylinders are general purpose cylinders from 10 to 100 ton, listed in 14 part numbers, such as 13040, 13020 and 13090. The listing gives capacities of 10 and 25 ton and strokes from 4-1/8 in to 10-1/8 in.

faqs.q: What models and part numbers are listed for the AME International hydraulic cylinders?
faqs.a: The AME International hydraulic cylinders are listed as 14 part numbers, for example 13040, 13076 and 13165. Together they cover stroke 1.5" to 10.125", capacity 25 ton to 100 ton, retracted length 3.2" to 15.6" and extended length 19.1". Quote the part number, or the capacity and size you need, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the AME International hydraulic cylinders?
faqs.a: Choose the capacity for the load with margin, 10, 25 or up to 100 ton, and the stroke for the full travel needed, such as 8 in for 13040 or 6 in for 13100. High-pressure tooling cylinders run at up to 700 bar (10,000 psi) and need a matching pump, hose and gauge.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the AME International hydraulic cylinders have?
faqs.a: The listing gives capacities and strokes but no rated pressure on the rows. High-pressure tooling cylinders run at up to 700 bar (10,000 psi) and need a matching pump, hose and gauge, so give us the part number and we confirm the rating with the maker.

faqs.q: What are the AME International hydraulic cylinders made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the material of the AME cylinders. Give us the part number and we confirm the body and seal material with the maker.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the AME International hydraulic cylinders?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO or ASME standard for the AME International hydraulic cylinders and holds no certificates. The maker's catalogue states the capacity and rated pressure for each part number, and a pump, hose, coupler and gauge rated to the same pressure are needed. If your site requires a test certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts do the AME International hydraulic cylinders mate with?
faqs.a: The AME International hydraulic cylinders need a pump, hose, coupler and gauge rated to the cylinder's pressure, because a circuit is limited by its lowest-rated component. Base plates and attachments for RC cylinders are on [the Enerpac cylinder accessories listing](/p/enerpac-cylinder-accessories).

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the AME International hydraulic cylinders?
faqs.a: Keep the AME International hydraulic cylinders square to the load, use a base plate or saddle where the maker lists one, and never exceed the rated pressure or the stroke. Check the plunger for scoring and the couplers for leaks, and bleed the air before loading.

faqs.q: Where are the AME International hydraulic cylinders used?
faqs.a: The AME International hydraulic cylinders are used for general pushing, pressing and lifting in workshops and maintenance, where a 10 or 25 ton cylinder is wanted.

faqs.q: How do the AME International hydraulic cylinders differ from Enerpac General Purpose Hydraulic Cylinders?
faqs.a: The AME cylinders are 14 part numbers from 10 to 100 ton, while [Enerpac General Purpose Hydraulic Cylinders](/p/enerpac-general-purpose-hydraulic-cylinders) are 8 part numbers rated in lb with a saddle included. Choose AME for the larger capacities.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the AME International hydraulic cylinders?
faqs.a: We ship the AME International hydraulic cylinders from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.a: Yes, we hold the AME International hydraulic cylinders in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Request pricing for your part numbers through [our contact page](/contact).
